title: Tree view for nested items
when: The user wants an expandable tree of nested items, such as folders and files, categories or an outline.
prompt:
Goal: A WAI-ARIA tree with roving focus and the full arrow key model, built safely from nested data.
Steps:
1. <ul role="tree" aria-label="Files">; each node is <li role="treeitem" aria-selected="false">, parents add aria-expanded and hold children in <ul role="group">.
2. Build it recursively from data with createElement and textContent.
3. Roving tabindex: only one treeitem has tabindex="0".
4. Keys: Down and Up go to the next and previous visible item; Right opens a closed parent or goes to its first child; Left closes an open parent or goes to the parent; Home, End; Enter activates.
5. Type ahead: a printable key moves to the next visible item starting with it.
6. Show expand state with a CSS chevron on [aria-expanded]; for simple site navigation prefer nested link lists with disclosure buttons.
Quality bar:
- Focus never lands on a hidden child.
- Indentation shows depth clearly.
- Selection is visible without color.
Pitfalls:
- Every item in the Tab order.
- Click only expand icons.
- Rebuilding the whole tree on each toggle and losing focus.
Verify:
- [ ] tree, treeitem and group roles are set.
- [ ] Arrow keys follow the model.
- [ ] One item has tabindex 0.
- [ ] Nodes are built with textContent.
Output: Tree container markup, tree.css and tree.js reading the data array.

examples.input: arvore de pastas e arquivos expansivel
examples.output: role tree built from nested data, roving focus, Right opens, Left closes, type ahead by first letter
